verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say it captures receipts automatically and fills in memos and categories, and its OCR reads line items. It codes transactions to GL accounts, and its AI 'teammates' flag fraud and scan transactions in real time for anomalies. The CLI also exposes memo-suggestions for agents. Missing for 10: explicit duplicate-detection evidence, depth on how fraud and anomaly detection works beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy.
